**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (at fallback).**

- **Responsive language:** §5a minimum monthly fee floor; §6 (no right to contest the minimum monthly fees); §13 one-year term with 30-day non-renewal; §14 Client's election to terminate.
- **Why not preferred:** a minimum monthly fee floor exists for both Hosting and Support Services, so fees are not purely usage/ordered-services based.
- **Why fallback is met:** the commitment is confined to the current 12-month term (no multi-year take-or-pay), Client holds an unconditional termination election that releases the floor on short notice, and the floor works as a pay-the-greater-of true-up with no shortfall penalty or acceleration anywhere in the document. No redline proposed, consistent with the playbook rule that a fallback-level clause is accepted rather than upgraded.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the §14 exit bites at month-end following notice (up to ~60 days) rather than a flat 30 days, and the §5a minimum amounts (and §4 Support Services period) are still blanks to be filled commercially. §3(i)'s per-borrower credit-report ordering duty is conditioned on voluntary Interface use with express freedom to use alternatives (§2a), so it is not a volume commitment; §13 non-renewal is left to the RENEWAL rule to avoid double-flagging.
